Sandbox_VB_Challenges_PointMultiplier_to: Multiplies the score points every challenge gives. Default 1.0.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_LevelCurveMultipli: Multiplies the score needed for each challenge level. Higher means slower progression. Default 1.0.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_OfferCount_tooltip: How many challenges you can choose from when picking a new one. Default 3.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_AbandonLockDays: Days before a challenge can be abandoned
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_AbandonLockDays_to: In-game days after accepting before a challenge can be abandoned. 0 = any time. Default 5.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_EnableLocationChal: Challenges that send you to real buildings (scout, supply run, night stays). Default on.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_LocationDistanceMu: Multiplies how far away location challenge targets can be. Default 1.0.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_EnableLocationCach: Reaching a location challenge's building hides a bag of supplies somewhere inside it to find. Default on.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_EnableAnimalChalle: Challenges about farm animals (petting, eggs, milking, shearing, butchering). Basic ones can be offered to anyone; farming ones need Animal Care level 1. Default on.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_MaxModifiers_toolt: How many risk modifiers can be added to one challenge. 0 disables risk modifiers. Default 2.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_ModifierBonusPerce: Extra score points per risk modifier, in percent. Default 50.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_DeadlineMultiplier: Multiplies the Deadline modifier's time limit (3 / 7 / 12 days by default).
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_EnableItemRewards_: Level-up rewards can be supply drops. Default on.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_EnableXpRewards_to: Level-up rewards can be skill XP. Default on.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_EnableTokenRewards: Level-up rewards can be reroll tokens and bounty contracts. Default on.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_EnableTraitRewards: Level-up rewards can grant positive traits or remove negative ones. Default on.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_TraitRewardEvery_t: Every N levels, one reward choice is a trait. Default 5.
Sandbox_VB_Challenges_XpRewardMultiplier: Multiplies the XP given by Training rewards. Default 1.0.
